description.p: Build random or custom scrambles from 2×2 up to 1001×1001, solve from the visible sticker state with the RCube and Gullicube native engines or the Rust reduction solvers, and watch the moves animate in 3D.
Solutions are replayed through the cube model up to 21×21; larger native solves rely on the engine's solved-state result and are labelled as unverified.
